helpers.name: w1_lscNarrow_integralContOn_lip
helpers.one_line_math: For any 1-Lipschitz function φ : PhaseSpace d → ℝ and Vlasov solution f with HasFiniteFirstMoment at each t, the map t ↦ ∫ φ d(f t) is continuous on Set.Icc 0 T. This is the technical heart of the LSC proof: approximate φ by compactly-supported smooth functions φ_ε using ContDiffBump mollifiers, apply W1ContOn_integralContAt to each φ_ε, then use dominated convergence controlled by HasFiniteFirstMoment (the norm ‖z‖ integrable bound) to pass the limit.

helpers.name: w1_lscNarrow_diff_contOn
helpers.one_line_math: For any 1-Lipschitz φ, the map t ↦ ∫ φ d(f t) - ∫ φ d(g t) is continuous on Set.Icc 0 T, as a difference of two continuous functions given by w1_lscNarrow_integralContOn_lip applied to f and g.
helpers.proof_sketch:
intro φ hφ_lip
exact (w1_lscNarrow_integralContOn_lip gradW f hf hf_prob T hT φ hφ_lip).sub
  (w1_lscNarrow_integralContOn_lip gradW g hg hg_prob T hT φ hφ_lip)

helpers.name: w1_lscNarrow_summand_lscOn
helpers.one_line_math: For any 1-Lipschitz φ, the map t ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ φ d(f t) - ∫ φ d(g t)) is lower semicontinuous on Set.Icc 0 T, since ENNReal.ofReal is continuous (hence LSC) and the inner map is continuous by w1_lscNarrow_diff_contOn.
helpers.proof_sketch:
intro φ hφ_lip
exact ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.lowerSemicontinuous.comp_continuousOn
  (w1_lscNarrow_diff_contOn gradW f g hf hg hf_prob hg_prob T hT φ hφ_lip)

helpers.name: w1_lscNarrow_of_summands
helpers.one_line_math: The Wasserstein-1 distance, defined as the double supremum ⨆ φ (_ : LipschitzWith 1 φ), ENNReal.ofReal (∫ φ d(f t) - ∫ φ d(g t)), is lower semicontinuous on Set.Icc 0 T as a supremum of LSC functions (via lowerSemicontinuousOn_biSup).
helpers.proof_sketch:
unfold wasserstein1
exact lowerSemicontinuousOn_iSup (fun φ =>
  lowerSemicontinuousOn_iSup (fun hφ =>
    w1_lscNarrow_summand_lscOn gradW f g hf hg hf_prob hg_prob T hT φ hφ))

residual_glue.strategy: The parent theorem body unfolds the wasserstein1 KR-dual sup and delegates to w1_lscNarrow_of_summands, which composes the helper chain.
